## e46c2557ad08

Generator SHA-256 `49cc19e227b5563a07b74abf4700bed89470194952630154b647a64780e946f0`.
Rule SHA-256 `bba257d19e2b9ed977892b09ef1fa837029e8c9a96a819e0d356d2c04f708f44`.

**A1-axis — reproduced override-contract defect.** `generate(0, 0, domino_count=6)`
uses the documented `1..6` range but raises
`ValueError: draw_int('domino_count'): override 6 outside [2, 4]`.
No input/output pair is invented: generation stops before Racket can execute.
Exact source hashes, arguments and exception are retained in
`checks/audit-e46c2557ad08-A1-axis.json`.

**A1-color — possible shortcut / domain question, not a generated-label defect.**
The input promise is all-gray objects. A color-blind horizontal-domino recoloring
rival matches **3/3 canonical pairs** and **256/256 ordinary evaluations**. A
constructed 7×9 grid contains a gray two-cell horizontal object at row 1, columns
1–2 and a blue two-cell object at row 4, columns 5–6 (zero-based). Actual Racket
recolors only gray to cyan; the rival also recolors blue. See
`checks/audit-e46c2557ad08-A1-color.json` for the entire grid and both outputs.

The constructed colored object is **outside the documented all-gray generator
domain**. There is **no target validator**, so validator success is not claimed.
Decide whether color discrimination belongs in this generator's intended training
objective before expanding its domain; the current in-domain shortcut can be
intentional equivalence, not necessarily a defect. Independent correct-rule
mirror matches actual Racket on all 256 ordinary evaluations and all canonical
labels match the published outputs. No malformed generated label was observed.

triage.reason: Both audit reports and executable reproducers fully read and retained. Census claims remain reviewer-reported; untouched audit targets were not locally rerun or edited.
